content.thinking: I'm counting the "Issued" records from 2024 by issue date, across all statuses, which comes to 17,104.

content.text:
Austin issued **17,104 electrical permits in 2024**.

This counts every electrical permit with an issue date from January 1 to December 31, 2024, whatever its status is now (still issued, finaled, expired or cancelled). The number comes from the city's own data portal, so it covers all matching permits rather than a sample. Austin publishes electrical permits in the same dataset as building permits, so none are missing.

FINAL ANSWER: 17104
